categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, and sales of analog integrated circuits, focusing on battery management chips and extending to various power management chips including battery safety chips, battery metering chips, and charging management chips. These products are widely applied in consumer electronics such as smartphones, tablets, TWS earphones, POS machines, AIoT devices, as well as industrial applications like electric tools, light electric vehicles, cordless appliances, drones, and AR/VR devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs proprietary core technologies including battery characteristic analysis, extraction and modeling, low offset error current collection, high-precision battery metering algorithms, multi-channel high-voltage acquisition, high-voltage switching, high-precision voltage reference design, ultra-low power circuit design, system-level ESD protection, and low-power battery disconnection detection. It follows a fabless business model, outsourcing wafer manufacturing and packaging/testing to specialized foundries and subcontractors, focusing on chip design and sales.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include well-known domestic and international brands in consumer electronics and industrial sectors such as Dell, HP, Lenovo, Samsung, Stanley Black & Decker, TTI, OPPO, Xiaomi, and others. The company serves markets including smartphones, tablets, smart wearable devices, electric tools, light electric vehicles, cordless home appliances, drones, and AIoT devices.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with its headquarters and main offices located in Dongguan, Guangdong Province, and subsidiaries in Shanghai. Its sales are predominantly domestic (78.35%) with a significant portion (21.65%) from overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Operating as a fabless semiconductor design company, the company is positioned midstream in the supply chain, focusing on chip design and sales while outsourcing wafer fabrication and packaging/testing to upstream foundries and downstream assembly providers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technological innovation with strategic focus on high-precision, high-safety, high-stability, and ultra-low power analog chips. It invests heavily in R&D (32.26% of revenue in 2023) to upgrade existing products and develop new ones, including high-voltage analog front ends, high-string battery management chips, and advanced power management solutions. It is expanding into new energy storage and electric vehicle battery management systems, aiming to enhance core technologies and broaden market coverage.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of analog integrated circuit products, including battery management chips and power management chips. The company uses a sales model dominated by buyout distribution channels complemented by direct sales to customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international leaders such as Texas Instruments (TI) and Analog Devices (ADI) in the battery management chip sector. It is one of the few domestic companies covering the full range of battery management chips, with competitive product performance and growing market share, especially in China. It is recognized as a major domestic supplier with strong brand reputation and customer loyalty.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 249.3 million, a 24.76% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 59.77 million, up 15.26%. The company has total assets of about RMB 1.75 billion and net assets of RMB 1.68 billion, showing steady growth. R&D investment increased by 22.16% to RMB 80.43 million, reflecting a strong growth trajectory supported by innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high-precision, high-safety, high-stability, and ultra-low power analog chips that effectively address battery state monitoring, charge estimation, and safety management. Its products feature advanced proprietary algorithms like 'FastCali' for battery metering, innovative architectures for battery safety, and strong anti-interference and high-voltage tolerance. The company emphasizes product reliability, technical support, and close customer collaboration, providing differentiated, high-value solutions tailored to diverse industrial and consumer applications.
